user.title: Create weather calendar
user.description: Select an existing daily-forecast weather entity. Optional templates accept {icon}, {condition}, {high}, {low}, {unit}, {location}, {date}, {title} and {details}. Leave blank for standard text. Home sun times and the Open-Meteo supplement use your HA home location; enable only for a source at home. Public ICS exposes the configured name, location and event text without a login. External subscribers require internet-accessible HTTPS Home Assistant. Calendar clients control refresh timing.

data.name: Calendar name
data.dashboard_details: Include Open-Meteo home details and local-day fallback

error.daily_forecast_required: Choose a weather entity that supports daily forecasts.
error.empty_name: Enter a calendar name and location label.
error.invalid_template: Use only the documented plain placeholders, with at most 2000 characters. Expressions, format modifiers and attribute access are not supported.
